lanes.drift_found:
1. SECTOR_CENTRAL GAP IN ENGINE-RENDER — CONFIRMED STILL EXISTS:

  engine-render.yml line 307: `spine; band; hub; us_pages; libs`
  render.yml line 324: `spine; band; central; hub; us_pages; libs`

  engine-render.yml defines NO `central()` function and never calls `scripts.build_sector_central`. The grep `sector_central` in engine-render.yml returns zero hits in the run section (only appears in comment lines 19 and 339). render.yml defines `central()` at line 229 and calls it in the `all` scope (line 324) and `macro` scope (line 326) and `baskets` scope (line 354). daily.yml runs it as a named serial step at line 466-473. Engine-render omits it entirely with no documented justification.

2. CL_MISC CONTENTS DIFFER ACROSS THREE LANES:

  daily.yml cl_misc (lines 435-443): build_seasonality, build_reports, build_cycle, build_sector_cycles, build_country_cycles, engine.policy_intent_desk, build_policy_watch, build_index_changes

  render.yml cl_misc: build_seasonality, build_reports, build_sector_cycles, build_country_cycles, build_cycle, build_markets, engine.policy_intent_desk, build_policy_watch, build_index_changes
  — render adds build_markets; order differs (sectorcyc before cycle in render vs cycle before sectorcyc in daily)

  engine-render.yml cl_misc (lines 248-260): build_seasonality, build_reports, build_policy_watch, build_index_changes ONLY
  — omits build_sector_cycles, build_country_cycles, build_cycle, build_markets (no documented justification for sector_cycles/country_cycles/cycle/markets omission — only policy_intent_desk omission is documented with a comment)

3. CL_BASKETS CONTENTS DIFFER — DAILY VS RENDER/ENGINE-RENDER:

  daily.yml cl_baskets: build_baskets → build_subsector_confluence → build_subsector_confluence --nasdaq → build_subsector_confluence --russell → build_cohort_metrics → build_news → build_methodology

  render.yml cl_baskets: build_baskets → build_news → build_methodology (omits subsector_confluence ×3 and cohort_metrics — no documented justification)

  engine-render.yml cl_baskets: build_baskets → build_news → build_methodology (same subset as render, same undocumented omission)

4. CL_GEX: build_gex_board present in daily.yml and render.yml but DELIBERATELY omitted from engine-render.yml (documented comment at engine-render.yml lines 223-235: live Cboe CDN fetch breaks "no network" invariant).

5. CL_CHINA/CL_HK CLUSTER MEMBERSHIP:

  daily.yml band: does NOT include cl_china or cl_hk (moved to asia-close.yml)
  render.yml band (line 277): includes cl_china (single: build_china) and cl_hk (single: build_hk)
  engine-render.yml band (line 261): includes cl_china (single: build_china) and cl_hk (single: build_hk)

6. POST-BAND MODULE GAPS — ENGINE-RENDER VS DAILY:

  daily.yml runs after the band: master_brain_scorer, master_brain, ai_desk_scorer, demand_ledger, demand_chain_phase0, ai_desk, narrative_brain, risk_brain, risk_radar_review, radar_scorer, grade_us_board, build_calibration, altdata_brain, build_radar_plus/ic/page, build_intelligence, build_briefing, build_intel_hub, build_aibrief, build_mastermind, build_ai_desk_page, notify, archive_signals, signal_sanity, build_whitehouse, inject_wh_banner, inject_data_base, oracle_nightly, build_world_state.

  engine-render.yml runs: only build_world_state (line 146) — placed BEFORE the render step as the "neural-web W1 express lane" step. ALL other post-band modules absent. This is documented in the header comment as deliberate (LLM brains/scorers/ledgers/EDGAR/notify/archive belong to the nightly).

7. WEEKLY.YM — BUILD ORDER DIVERGES FROM DAILY:

  weekly.yml runs engine.run (step 9) BEFORE build_china/build_hk (steps 15/18), which matches daily. But weekly runs build_spvector → build_site immediately after engine.run, then china calibrate → build_china → hk calibrate → build_hk → commodities calibrate → build_commodities → bonds calibrate → build_bonds → transmission calibrate → build_transmission → calibrate_vector → validate_gex → build_vector → build_aibrief — all serial, NO parallelism. The band cluster structure is absent entirely. build_baskets, build_news, build_sector_cycles, build_country_cycles, build_subsector_confluence, build_sector_central, and most US-only builders are omitted from weekly.
lanes.notes:
1. engine-render.yml DELIBERATE omissions (documented with comments in the file):
   - build_gex_board: omitted from cl_gex because it fetches live Cboe CDN option chains (~22 min, breaks the no-network invariant); documented at engine-render.yml lines 223-235.
   - engine.policy_intent_desk: omitted from cl_misc because it is an LLM builder (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY required, SIGABRT without it); documented at engine-render.yml lines 249-255.
   - ALL LLM brains and their scorers/ledgers (master_brain, ai_desk, narrative_brain, risk_brain, altdata_brain, risk_radar_review, radar_scorer, demand_ledger, ai_desk_scorer): documented in the engine-render.yml header (lines 17-19) as the nightly's exclusive domain; the express lane carries NO secrets.
   - build_special_situations (EDGAR sweep): documented in header as deliberately skipped.
   - notify, archive_signals: documented in header as nightly side-effects.
   - factor_series / stock_briefs: run in isolated parallel daily.yml jobs, not in any render lane.

2. asia-close.yml DELIBERATE divergence: cl_china and cl_hk were MOVED from daily.yml to asia-close.yml (runs 08:30 UTC after HK cash close) so CN/HK pages render settled closes instead of stale marks. The comment in daily.yml at lines 413-415 documents this migration explicitly. render.yml and engine-render.yml still include cl_china/cl_hk in their band because those lanes use committed data (no timing dependency).

3. render.yml cl_misc includes build_markets and build_cycle in a different order vs daily.yml (render: sectorcyc → countrycyc → cycle → markets; daily: cycle → sectorcyc → countrycyc; no markets). The build_markets addition and order difference in render.yml are not documented with a comment and represent real drift for the checker.

4. intraday-fastpath.yml is event-driven (every 30 min during RTH) and intentionally only runs the three fast price-driven steps (refresh_regime_if_stale, build_live_overlay, build_risk_state) — this is the documented fast/slow split design; the checker must not flag these as missing.

5. sentinel workflows (vector-sentinel, commodity-sentinel, whitehouse-sentinel) are event-driven, committing only on state transitions — their minimal module sets are by design and must not be flagged as drift.

EVENT-DRIVEN modules (respond to external state, not purely deterministic over committed data):
- scripts.build_gex_board: fetches ~700 live CBOE option chains at build time (cdn.cboe.com, HTTP 429-rate-limited, ~22 min). DELIBERATELY omitted from engine-render auto (push-triggered) path per engine-render.yml lines 218-226; runs only in daily.yml cl_gex cluster and manual scope=gex dispatch.
- engine.policy_intent_desk: LLM builder (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); DELIBERATELY omitted from engine-render.yml cl_misc per lines 236-244 (exits rc=134 without key). Runs daily.yml cl_misc only.
- engine.master_brain, engine.ai_desk, engine.narrative_brain, engine.risk_brain, engine.altdata_brain: LLM builders (DEEPSEEK or ANTHROPIC key). Run after the parallel band in daily.yml engine job. ALL omitted from engine-render (the lane's stated invariant is no LLM/secrets).
- scripts.oracle_nightly: event-driven (detects new rotation complexes vs prior state by diffing oracle_state). Collector = NO, Builder = YES, but its alerting logic is inherently reactive to prior state.
- scripts.publish_r2: outward-facing network (uploads to Cloudflare R2 via boto3 S3 API). Both impure AND needs_secrets (R2_ENDPOINT, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET).

DRIFT FINDING — engine-render.yml omits sector_central (CONFIRMED STILL TRUE):
- daily.yml engine job has an explicit serial step at line 452-459: 'US sector central intelligence (build_sector_central)' → python -m scripts.build_sector_central
- engine-render.yml has NO invocation of scripts.build_sector_central anywhere in its builder set (confirmed grep: zero hits). The comment at engine-render.yml line 325 mentions 'sector_central' only as a read-dependency of build_stock_board_v2, not as a step that runs.
- This is a DELIBERATE semantic divergence documented in the engine-render lane header: 'DELIBERATELY skipped (belong to the nightly): ...' — but sector_central is NOT in that explicit skip list. The omission appears unintentional. The writes it produces (data/sector_central/calls.parquet, site/factordata/sector_central.json, site/sector_central_data.js) depend on cl_baskets completing first (baskets.json) AND cl_misc completing (sector_cycles_data.js), both of which DO run in engine-render. The barrier for those two exists at engine-render.yml line 246. So the dependency is satisfiable but the step is simply absent.

COLLECTOR vs BUILDER classification:
- All modules listed under 'modules' are BUILDERS (read committed data, write site/ or data/ artifacts, no upstream collection).
- scripts.build_stock_library is MIXED: pure computation PLUS optional per-build drip fetches (SEC/Wikipedia equity_profile, edgar_rpo, edgar_headcount) which are network calls and are suppressed in engine-render via RENDER_NO_DRIP=1 (build_stock_library.py line 497-504). In dag.yml these should be flagged impure=conditional.

IO STATIC DETERMINATION:
- scripts.build_site IO cannot be fully statically determined: it imports build_subsector_rotation, build_stock_library, and market_state.persist() inline at runtime (lines 3209, 1700), so its full write surface is a superset of what its module-level imports reveal. The dag.yml checker must treat build_site's declared outputs as a lower bound and allow declared-divergence annotations for the inline calls.
io.notes:
RECOMMENDED dag.yml GRANULARITY: per-workflow-step, not per-Python-module.

Rationale:
1. Several modules are invoked multiple times at different points in the pipeline with different roles. build_alt_data runs twice in daily.yml (once in the spine at line 317, once re-rendered after altdata_brain at line 638). build_stock_library is called from inside build_site at runtime rather than as a direct step. build_subsector_rotation is called from inside build_site line 3209. Declaring these at per-module granularity loses the ordering and re-run semantics the checker needs.

2. The parallel band (cl_markets, cl_gex, cl_baskets, cl_misc, cl_special) is the natural unit of validation: the DAG checker must verify that no module inside a band reads an artifact written by another module in the SAME band (cross-band reads are the bug class). Per-step granularity exposes this; per-module granularity hides it.

3. The engine-render lane explicitly documents 'keep in sync with render.yml' (engine-render.yml line 22-24). A step-level dag.yml makes this diff mechanical: the checker compares the declared band set in each lane and reds on divergence. With per-module granularity there is no natural way to express 'this step belongs to cl_baskets in daily but cl_china in engine-render'.

4. The validate-only conformance checker (N5 spec) needs to diff declared DAG against HAND-WRITTEN workflow lanes. Workflow lanes are step-level constructs. A step-level dag.yml maps 1:1 onto the YAML and makes the diff tractable. A module-level dag.yml requires reconstructing which steps invoke which modules — adding a layer of inference the checker would have to perform.

5. DELIBERATE DIVERGENCES to preserve in dag.yml (do not flatten):
   - build_gex_board: runs in daily cl_gex but is omitted from engine-render auto (push-triggered) path; only runs in engine-render on manual scope=gex. Declare a divergence annotation: lane=engine-render, scope=auto, reason=live-network-invariant.
   - policy_intent_desk: runs in daily cl_misc but is entirely absent from engine-render. Declare divergence: lane=engine-render, reason=needs-LLM-key.
   - sector_central: runs in daily as a POST-BAND serial step but is ABSENT from engine-render. This is the unintentional omission per the task context. The checker should RED on this specific divergence unless a declared divergence annotation is added.
   - build_world_state: runs in daily engine job AND in engine-render (per the comment at daily.yml line 811); this is a CONVERGENCE that should be verified present in both lanes.
   - All LLM brains (master_brain, ai_desk, narrative_brain, risk_brain, altdata_brain): run in daily engine job, absent from engine-render; declare as deliberate divergence (engine-render header explicitly says these are skipped).
